mapper.insert: INSERT INTO checkin_memory_candidates (id,user_id,checkin_id,source_hash,ordinal_index,category,memory_text,status,created_at) VALUES (#{id},#{userId},#{checkinId},#{sourceHash},#{ordinalIndex},#{category},#{memoryText},#{status},#{createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE category=IF(status='invalidated',VALUES(category),category), memory_text=IF(status='invalidated',VALUES(memory_text),memory_text), status=IF(status='invalidated','pending',status)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM checkin_memory_candidates WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM checkin_memory_candidates WHERE checkin_id=#{checkinId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='pending' ORDER BY ordinal_index ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE checkin_memory_candidates SET status='invalidated' WHERE checkin_id=#{checkinId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='pending'
UPDATE checkin_memory_candidates SET status=#{status}, confirmed_at=#{confirmedAt}, memory_text=COALESCE(#{text},memory_text) WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='pending'
